target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier/catalog && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode ghost_catalog.tex >/tmp/gcat.log 2>&1; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode ghost_catalog.tex >/tmp/gcat.log 2>&1; grep -cE "^!" /tmp/gcat.log; pdfinfo ghost_catalog.pdf | grep Pages; rm -f ghost_catalog.aux ghost_catalog.log ghost_catalog.out
cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/catalog/ghost_catalog.tex shadow_frontier/catalog/ghost_catalog.pdf && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
ghost catalog: June-2026 constraints section + surviving candidate list

New section between the negative cycles and the elevator pitch:
- catalog-form summary of the post-compilation theorem stack (exact
  narrow-band D*=1.246/5.63, log dwell at ratio 2, dual phase-diagram
  lines 1.246/0.449, two clocks + universal ghost clock with ride cap
  floor((a-1)/K), census R=0.0882, without-replacement supply +
  upcrossings 2^{k-3} + escape O(X log X), iid fair-thirds survival
  coin with LTE-deterministic ghost-aligned seeds, entropy deficit
  theta_12 < 0.9791, blind-spot constraints: 2/3 log2(x0) free moves
  then forced carry regime, K(word) <= log2(x0)+O(1), 66 of 2^30
  words realized below 10^6).
- composite counterexample profile paragraph.
- THE CANDIDATE LIST: six surviving structural profiles C1-C6
  (carry-cascade impostor; binary CIC violator; -19/11 parity rider;
  3-smooth/Mersenne ghost-aligned seeds incl. family champion
  2^705-1; high cycles at log2(3) convergents; exponent-level
  ghost-log conspirator), each with best known approximants and the
  exact meter that taxes it. Closing: the list is a specification of
  where a counterexample would have to hide; C1 is the quenched
  calibration wall to which all known frameworks reduce.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 2 --text "ghost_catalog.tex updated: new section 'The June 2026 constraints, and the surviving candidate list' inserted after the negative cycles, before the elevator pitch. Catalog-form constraint stack (D*=1.246/5.63 exact, eps_bin=0.449, two clocks, universal ghost clock, census R=0.0882, supply/upcrossing/escape, iid survival coin + LTE-deterministic seeds, theta_12<0.9791, blind-spot finite-seed determinism + countability 66/2^30) + composite profile + candidate list C1-C6 (carry-cascade impostor / binary CIC violator / -19/11 parity rider / 3-smooth-Mersenne seeds with family champion 2^705-1 / convergent-shaped high cycles / exponent-level ghost-log conspirator), each with approximants + taxing meter. Framing: a specification of hiding places, not evidence of existence; C1 = the quenched wall." 2>&1 | tail -1 && ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
